description: Implementation of the ProductFileManager interface handling product image processing, uploading, retrieval, and removal. Contains methods for adding images, cropping, resizing, and managing product-related image files in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductFileManagerImpl
classes.description: Implements functionality for managing product image files including upload, retrieval, cropping, resizing, and deletion within an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Processes and uploads a product image, including optional cropping and resizing based on configuration.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product image in original or specified size.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves list of images associated with a product or merchant store.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images associated with a product.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a given merchant store.
